description.what: Buyback & Burn uses part of the trading fees to buy back the token from the market and burn it permanently. This helps reduce circulating supply and support the token's long-term structure.
how: When trades occur, part of the allocated fees is accumulated.
Once a preset threshold is reached, the accumulated fees are used to buy back the token from the market.
The purchased tokens are burned immediately and cannot re-enter circulation.
rules: The allocated fees are used only for this token's Buyback & Burn.
Purchased tokens are burned immediately and are not sent to any other wallet.
No manual claim or additional user action is required.
description.importantNote: Buyback & Burn helps reduce circulating supply and support the token's structure. It does not guarantee price increases or returns.
